lines: When you keep checking if they care, you crave approval.
You send a text, you call, then you wait.
Every silent reply feels like a personal loss.
Confidence drops each time the phone stays quiet.
They won’t give the love you keep hunting.
The real proof is how they act when you’re not watching.
Find someone who loves you without needing a reminder, you deserve that.
